cases: Minigames/Perf › 'T-PERF-02 judge at each family's cap, median of PERF_RUNS: HoldZone's 1,024 records, TimingStrike's 512 presses and the trace's 1,479 samples spread over travel ≤ REPLAY_BUDGET_MS' (t.slow). Inputs: (1) HoldZone Steel/Hard x = 1, seed 10, through H.prepared: 512 strokes, a down every 35 ms from GO held 15 ms (the prototype's cost2.luau stroke was 36/15 ms; this spacing fits the cap). Asserts durationMs 18,000, #records 1,024, recordCap 1,024. (2) TimingStrike Steel/Hard x = 1, seed 10: 512 presses spread evenly over the step, press i at floor(i·durationMs/511), with durationMs 10,887 at seed 10. Asserts 512 presses and recordCap 512. (3) The trace: worst.luau's source built exactly as PrecisionTrace.spec builds it (a 256-point sine, amplitude 0.198). PT.generate(10, Iron/Normal x = 0 params) gives the pattern. The StepSpec is built by hand as hostile.luau does, because prepare takes an edge; Minigames.start(spec) confirms its hash. Asserts 256 source points, length 8.54 against the 8.55 u bound, durationMs 29,560, and recordCap = floor(29,560/20) + 1 = 1,479. The spread timeline has sample i = 0…1,478 at leadInMs + floor(i·travelMs/1,478), each on the pacer (H.fixed of pointAt(pacerArc(t))) and grinding. Asserts 1,479 records running from leadInMs to leadInMs + travelMs. (4) The honest timeline is H.onPacer(P, 20): 1,479 samples from GO. (5) Decode's cap: 2,048 grinding samples on the pacer, one per 14 ms from GO (the plan's 'about 14 ms apart near the pacer'). Asserts 2,048 samples, judge returns Invalid TooMany, and the warm-up decode accepts all 2,048 (so the judge's cap refuses them after decode). Timed: judge on HZ, TS, the trace spread (asserted ≤ 8 ms) and the trace honest (reported); decode alone of the 2,048 buffer (reported). Every warm-up judge returns status Ok. Prints the asserted medians with their counts and durations, the honest median with the spread÷honest ratio, the decode median, and each of the 5 medians × 2.6 against 7 ms with a 'past it' list.

Minigames/Perf › 'T-PERF-02 prepare for Sharpening (the hand-off + generate), median of PERF_RUNS: X08's edges, Cost.X08_EDGE and the length-bound chain ≤ PT_GENERATE_BUDGET_MS' (t.slow). Edges: X08a (P2), X08b (P1) and X08c (P5) from Analyze.run(Cost.core(Cost.X08[alias])).edge, run before the timed part. Only the presence of an edge is asserted; the edges' content is not pinned (D5, D6). Then Cost.X08_EDGE (the zigzag) and the length-bound chain: 256 points, 0.331·sin(2π·10·i/255) across, 1.48 + 4.4·i/255 along, grip (0, 0.88, 0) and axis (0, 1), as wavehand.luau builds it. Asserts 256 chain points. At Iron/Normal x = 0 it asserts 256 source points, 7 E shrinks, 0 Douglas–Peucker attempts and length 8.53 of 8.55 u (len ≤ maxLen). At Steel/Hard x = 1 it asserts 256 source points and no Douglas–Peucker. For each edge at Iron/Normal x = 0 and at Steel/Hard x = 1 there are three timed calls: Minigames.prepare(H.inputFor(..., seed 10, edge)), asserted ≤ 5 ms; the hand-off PT.edgeToPanel(PT.sidesFromChains(...)), reported; and PT.generate(10, p, the hand-off's source), reported. Also asserted: prepare's patternHash equals generate's hash, so prepare is the hand-off plus generate. HoldZone and TimingStrike generate are timed at both configs and reported. Prints one line per edge: prepare = hand-off + generate in ms and × 2.6, with how the hand-off fitted the edge (points, E shrinks, attempts, length against the bound, or 'no source (short): the fallback'). Also prints HZ/TS generate with × 2.6 and the × 2.6 spans per group against 7 ms with a 'past it' list.

Method (shared measure()): T-PERF-01's. One warm-up run per timed call, whose results feed the checks. Then Tol.PERF_RUNS (15) rounds, odd rounds forward through the list and even rounds backward. Each timed run follows a full collection (luau.load('collectgarbage("collect")'), as in T-PERF-01). Each call's number is its median.

summary: T-PERF-02 is written in C:\Users\louis\Documents\RANDOM\ROBLOX\Blacksmithing Game\tests\Minigames\Perf.spec.luau (suite Minigames/Perf), and it passes alone in the repo: pass=2, 0.86 s by the runner, 3–18 % busy. One asserts Minigames.judge ≤ REPLAY_BUDGET_MS at each family's cap: HoldZone 1,024 records, TimingStrike 512 presses, and the trace at recordCap = 1,479 on the length-bound source, spread over travel and grinding on the pacer, as in hostile.luau part 2. Nothing under src/ changed, nothing was committed, and no process is left running. Points for the lead: X08b (P1) gives no source, so prepare there times the fallback path; and the length-bound chain costs more at Steel/Hard (2.5 ms) than at Iron/Normal (1.9 ms).
